parse.title: Magic Girl
parse.text:
Unobtainable Unit
This unit is currently unobtainable since Update 15.5 - Summer update

Overview

Magic Girl is a MythicalMythical Limited unit​. She can only be obtained via summons​ in the Limited-Time Event Banner.

Evolving

Magic Girl can evolve into Magic Girl (Salvation) with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Magic Girl
x1 Soul Gem (Rose)
Result
Magic Girl
(Salvation)

Before evolving this unit, the unit must have 5,000 Takedowns. [1]

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
